items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: And the nice thing about it is Jim Christenson, the first leader, who is still around, had a lot of stuff that he published for Disney, and so we

ctx.x: Well back in those days you were playing live music for all these things, and I would guess that nowadays much of that music is just prerecorded and played.

Yeah. We did live concerts — the thing that I really enjoyed, we did live concerts in Town Square, set up in the Square. And the nice thing about it is Jim Christenson, the first leader, who is still around, had a lot of stuff that he published for Disney, and so we

played a lot of that. We had a lot of guest conductors, guys that wrote some of these marches that I’d never even met them. And of course Meredith Wilson was there for the grand opening for Disney. You know, he was the — and he hung out in the band room. He loved everything. I mean what a great guy. And so that was — and here I am from Rock Island, Illinois. I hadn’t met anybody. And looking back I mean my move from Rock Island to Orlando was the best career move I could have ever made anywhere. I mean I met…
